tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Керолайн організувала благодійну мийку машин, і в неї суворі правила. Олена ставить Стефанові питання, на які він не хоче відповідати, а Бонні помітила, що Стефан ніколи не їсть. Ти миєш машину поруч із ними й чуєш кожне слово.
tasks.q_pl: Caroline zorganizowała charytatywną myjnię i ma surowe zasady. Elena zadaje Stefanowi pytania, na które on nie chce odpowiadać, a Bonnie zauważyła, że Stefan nigdy nie je. Myjesz samochód obok nich i słyszysz każde słowo.
tasks.q_en: Caroline has organised a charity car wash, and she has strict rules. Elena is asking Stefan questions he doesn't want to answer, and Bonnie has noticed that Stefan never eats. You're washing a car next to them and you hear every word.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: must = strong obligation, often the speaker's own rule (You must tell me). have to = obligation from outside rules (Everyone has to wash ten cars). mustn't = prohibition: don't do it! (You mustn't lie to me). don't have to = no obligation, it's your choice (You don't have to tell me now). Past of both must and have to: had to.
tasks.q_pl: must = strong obligation, often the speaker's own rule (You must tell me). have to = obligation from outside rules (Everyone has to wash ten cars). mustn't = prohibition: don't do it! (You mustn't lie to me). don't have to = no obligation, it's your choice (You don't have to tell me now). Past of both must and have to: had to.

end_good.text: Керолайн проходить повз і схвально киває: «Нарешті хтось розуміє правила!» Ти вперше бачиш її усмішку без сарказму.
